headline: Executive order expands US sanctions by freezing the property of more people tied to the situation in Venezuela.
what_it_does: This order adds to earlier US sanctions related to Venezuela. Based on its title, it allows the US government to block, or freeze, the property and assets in the United States of additional people found to be contributing to the situation in Venezuela. Blocking property usually also means Americans cannot do business with those people. No summary was provided, so the exact standards for who can be targeted are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: People and companies named under the order
who_it_affects.how: Their property and interests in property under US control can be frozen.
They would generally have to stop dealings with anyone whose property is blocked under the order.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed November 1, 2018; the title does not state a separate effective date.
